description: This file defines the core data models, state, actions, and reducer logic for a SwiftUI-based recipes application. It includes structures for application environment setup, app state management, action definitions for state mutations, and a reducer function that handles these actions, some involving asynchronous operations such as network fetches and file I/O.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Asynchronous method in RecipesService used to fetch recipes matching current query, filtering by health condition, and supporting pagination.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads file data from the specified path and filename in the application support directory.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file in the application support directory.
